how_cheat_d: Give me what matters. Two pages. Formulas, traps, and quick recognition cues.
how_blueprint_d: Show me how it works. A 5-step SEE → IDENTIFY → CHOOSE → EXECUTE → CHECK decision engine.
how_flash_d: Help me remember it. Real visual retrieval cards across 8 distinct types.
how_testme_d: Tell me if I'm ready. Foundation → Proficient → Advanced → Honors.
how_honors_d: Push me further. Why / What-If / Prove / Generalize / Defend — depth, not just harder numbers.
how_interactive_d: Show me / let me practice / help me think — curated pathways, only when they add value.
home_need: What do you need right now?
need1_b: I have a test / need it fast
eng_pick: Pick an area, then choose the kind of help you need.
eng_note: AI Tutor provides tutoring prompts and external resources; it is not a built-in conversational chatbot.
dash_eoc_d: Each assessment has 15 questions. The multiple-choice threshold is 12/15; written reasoning tasks have separate teacher review.
help_tour: How Do I Use This? · Show Me Around!
inv_p: Your math command center is ready. Want a quick, hands-on look around? About 60 seconds, at your pace.
tour_d1: This is your dashboard: your home base for all ten learning areas. You can explore freely. This tour never changes your learning scores.
tour_d2: The diagnostic checks what you know and builds a study plan from your answers. Look for the highlighted Diagnostic Assessment card. Your saved assessment is safe while you explore.
tour_d3: These are the real tools. Flip the highlighted flashcard with a click, Enter, or Space. Try Reveal Answer, then peek at a cheat sheet.
tour_d4: Try this real Foundation question from Test Me. This is tour practice only. A wrong answer is a clue, not a penalty!
tour_d5: Use your Study Plan to choose a lesson, then practice with the engines. Five EOCs check your progress. Export a backup before changing devices. You can replay this tour anytime.
tour_choose: Choose an answer. It will not affect your diagnostic or EOC records.
tour_yes: Yes! Subtract 9 from both sides: 4x = 24. Divide by 4: x = 6. Check: 4(6) + 9 = 24 + 9 = 33 ✓
tour_retry: Good try! Undo the +9 first, then divide by 4. Try again — you can do this.
tour_note: Optional tour. Use the highlighted real controls above. Escape exits anytime.
ctl_local: Progress stays in this browser; it is not a cloud account. Export a backup before changing devices.
coverage_notice: Translated in this language: dashboard, navigation, tour, diagnostic, EOC checkouts, results, and study plan. Still English only: Cheat Sheets, Blueprints, Flashcards, Test Me, Honors Layer, Interactive Support, expanded lessons, and written performance tasks.
save_failed: Progress could not be saved. Export a JSON backup now.
save_failed_alert: Progress could not be saved. Export a JSON backup from the Mastery Hub.
confirm_extended: Replace the diagnostic in progress with a new 40-question attempt?
confirm_import: Replace current progress with this validated backup?
confirm_reset: Delete all progress in this browser? Export a backup first.
diag_locked: This answer is locked. The adaptive diagnostic chose the next questions from it. Return to your newest question to continue.
plan_observed: Observed performance: {c}/{n} distinct questions. Recommendations combine the latest response to each item across diagnostic and EOC attempts; repeating the same question adds no proficiency evidence. Priority is prerequisite gaps, observed weakness, then curriculum order. Five distinct area responses and 80% correct establish provisional proficiency only.
plan_provisional: Provisional proficiency; confirm through a fresh assessment
plan_interval: Latest responses to {n} distinct questions. Descriptive 95% interval: {lo}–{hi}; this sample is adaptive and is not a calibrated ability estimate.
plan_no_error: No error observed in this sample; use transfer practice to confirm.
plan_study_next: Study the lesson, complete guided and independent practice, and check your answers.
plan_go_honors: Proceed to honors transfer and the next EOC.
plan_reassess: After correcting each missed skill and completing the lesson check, take a fresh reassessment.
plan_mis_recurring: {tag}: {d} distinct items, {o} error observations. Recurring pattern; explain the correction before reassessment.
plan_mis_candidate: {tag}: {d} distinct items, {o} error observations. Candidate error; further evidence required.
plan_mis_none: No specific recurring misconception has been established.
plan_eoc_met: 80% multiple-choice threshold met; continue with the performance task and next level.
plan_eoc_below: Below 80%; use the area and skill recommendations below before retaking.
lessons_en_only: These expanded lessons are authored in English. Their translation is not yet available.
eoc_written_d: Five supplementary tasks build from application to sustained investigations. Open a checkout result to draft and resume its written task. Checkouts 4 and 5 require multiple sessions, evidence comparison, revision, proof, and transfer. Written-task text is available in English only.
en_only_notice: This section's instructional content is currently available in English only. Its translation is in progress; your language choice is saved and the rest of the app stays in your language.
